## Inquiry #1 — Airbnb / PC-09 / Lauren M. — GREEN

**Inquiry received:** May 12, 7:42 AM MT
**Dates requested:** Jul 3–7, 2026 (4 nights; covers July 4 weekend)
**Property:** Hawkfeather Cabin — 4BR/3BA, sleeps 10
**Quoted total (Airbnb):** $4,925 nightly + $375 cleaning + $984 service = **$6,284**
**Group:** 8 adults + 2 kids (ages 6, 9)

**Original message:**
> Hi! Looking at Hawkfeather for July 4th weekend with our extended family. We're 4 couples + 2 kids. The kids are 6 and 9. Is the hot tub safe for kids that age (with parents in)? Also, can you confirm the cabin sleeps 10 comfortably (not just on paper) — we've been burned before by the "sleeps 10" claim. Thanks!

### Fit assessment

| Signal | Read |
|---|---|
| Dates align with min-stay rule (3-night weekend min, 4 nights here) | OK |
| Group size within max occupancy (10/10) | OK |
| Trip purpose (family + kids) — fits cabin demographic | Strong fit |
| Asks specific, thoughtful questions (hot tub safety, sleeping arrangement) | Excellent — engaged guest |
| Comm style — friendly, direct, transparent about prior bad experiences | Easy to host |
| **Score** | **GREEN** |

### Draft response

> Hi Lauren,
>
> Thanks so much for reaching out about Hawkfeather Cabin for July 4th weekend — that's one of our favorite weeks of the year up here.
>
> **On the hot tub for kids:** It's safe with parents in. The water is set to 102°F (we keep it dialed down for family-friendly use), and we recommend 15-minute max sessions for kids under 12. There's a child-safety cover that locks when not in use, plus a "rules" card next to the tub.
>
> **On sleep arrangements:** Hawkfeather sleeps 10 *comfortably*, not on a stretch. Here's the actual config: master king with ensuite, second king ensuite, queen + twin bunks (great for the kids), and a queen sleeper sofa in the loft. So that's 4 dedicated beds for the adults + 1 dedicated bed for one kid + the queen sofa for either the second kid or a fifth adult.
>
> Two questions before I pre-approve:
> 1. Do you need any pack-and-plays or high chairs?
> 2. Will any of the group be arriving Friday afternoon (Jul 3) — early check-in is 1 PM and we can sometimes do 12 PM for a small fee?
>
> Looking forward to hosting your family!
>
> — Riley
> Pinecrest Mountain Rentals

### Operational follow-up
- Pre-approve via Airbnb: dates Jul 3–7, total $6,284
- Save inquiry to `08-guests/inquiries/2026-05/lauren-m-pc-09.md`

## Inquiry #2 — VRBO / PC-21 / Brian K. — YELLOW

**Inquiry received:** May 11, 9:18 PM MT (responded next morning, 8 hr response time — at SLA limit)
**Dates requested:** May 22–25, 2026 (3 nights, Memorial Day weekend)
**Property:** The Boathouse — 3BR/2BA, sleeps 8
**Quoted total (VRBO):** $1,950 nightly + $295 cleaning + $156 service = **$2,401**
**Group:** "Group of friends, around 10 people"

**Original message:**
> Hey, looking at The Boathouse for Memorial Day weekend. We'd be a group of about 10 friends — most of us are 28-32. We'd be there to enjoy the lake, do some boating, hang out. The listing says "sleeps 8" but we have 10 people. Some of us are happy to bring sleeping bags or use the couches. Can we make it work? What's the deal with the boat dock — can we bring our own boat? Also, is there a cleaning fee on top of the $295 or is that all-in?

### Fit assessment

| Signal | Read |
|---|---|
| Dates align with min-stay rule (3-night holiday min, exact match) | OK |
| Group size **over** max occupancy (10 vs. 8 capacity) | YELLOW — explicit policy violation |
| Group composition — "friends, mid-late 20s, hang out" — historically higher noise complaint risk | YELLOW |
| Trip purpose (lake + boating) is on-brand for property | OK |
| Asks about cleaning fee (price-sensitive but reasonable) | Neutral |
| Comm style — casual, slightly evasive on group size ("about 10") | YELLOW |
| **Score** | **YELLOW — needs clarification, willing to host with right setup** |

### Draft response

> Hi Brian,
>
> Thanks for reaching out about The Boathouse for Memorial Day weekend!
>
> A few things I want to flag before we move forward:
>
> **On occupancy:** The Boathouse is licensed and insured for 8 guests max. This isn't a soft limit — it's tied to our Wasatch County STR permit and the septic system on the property. Bringing 10 isn't possible. If you can confirm the actual headcount at 8, we can move forward; if not, I'd suggest looking at PC-22 (Reservoir Bluff, sleeps 10) which is a 3-min walk away — I can quote that for you.
>
> **On the boat dock:** Yes, you can bring your own boat. The property has a private 30-ft slip on Jordanelle. Beach gear (kayaks, paddleboards, life jackets) is included. There's a $50 launch-fee at the public ramp, which Wasatch County collects directly.
>
> **On the cleaning fee:** The $295 is all-in — no additional cleaning fee. The total in your inquiry ($2,401) is the full price including taxes.
>
> A few questions for me:
> 1. What's the actual final headcount? If it's 8, I'm happy to pre-approve.
> 2. If you're at 10, want me to quote Reservoir Bluff instead?
> 3. Will the group include any kids?
>
> Thanks Brian — let me know either way!
>
> — Riley
> Pinecrest Mountain Rentals

**Inquiry received:** May 12, 1:14 AM MT (overnight — flagged for morning review)

**Property:** The Tinder Box — 2BR/1BA, sleeps 4
**Quoted total (Airbnb):** $1,090 nightly + $185 cleaning + $214 service = **$1,489**
**Group:** "8-10 people for my buddy's bachelor weekend"

**Original message:**
> What's up. Need a place for my buddy's bachelor party June 12-14. We'd be like 8-10 dudes. The cabin says sleeps 4 but we don't all need beds, plenty of us crash on couches/floor. Can we get a deal? We'd want to play music outside Friday night, have a fire pit thing, you know how it goes. Need to know about noise rules. Cash deal possible?

### Fit assessment

| Signal | Read |
|---|---|
| Dates align with min-stay rule (2-night Fri–Sun, OK) | OK |
| Group size — 8–10 vs. property max occupancy of 4 | **RED — 2x+ over capacity** |

### Draft decline response (channel-friendly tone)

> Hi Tyler,
>
> Thanks for reaching out about The Tinder Box for June 12–14.
>
> Unfortunately, we won't be able to host this booking. A few reasons I want to be upfront about:
>
> 1. The Tinder Box is licensed for 4 guests max. This is a Wasatch County STR permit limit, not a soft rule.
> 2. The property is in Old Town with shared walls and a strict HOA quiet-hours policy (10 PM–8 AM). Outdoor music and fire pit gatherings would put your group at risk of an HOA fine and us at risk of losing the permit.
> 3. We don't accept off-platform cash payments — all bookings go through Airbnb (or our direct site, pinecrestmountain.com).
>
> For a bachelor weekend with 8–10 people, I'd recommend looking at properties in Heber or Midway — there are larger party-friendly cabins that are licensed for that group size. Try [VRBO Heber Cabins page](https://www.vrbo.com/r/heber-city) for some options.
>
> Wishing you and your friends a great trip.
>
> — Riley
> Pinecrest Mountain Rentals

### Operational follow-up
- Decline via Airbnb (preserves listing rank — Airbnb's algorithm favors hosts who decline bad-fit inquiries with a polite reason vs. ignoring or accepting and then having issues)
